scope: Seven completed KST days of Korean (KMA) history in the existing mobile response: precipitation presence and type from hourly rows through the public three-hour slots to the AM/PM day halves.
not_a_claim: This contract does not certify seven-day history, source completeness, SKY, snow or LGT values, or latency.

availability.release: D-1 after 11:00 KST per the official guide

interval.nov-mar: rain over the preceding three hours, reported only at the 03..24 marks

dmstMtphNo.meaning: phenomena of the preceding hour, taken from the observation journal
dmstMtphNo.coverage: staffed hours only; absent at stations without phenomenon recording

availability.release: D-1 after 11:00 KST per the official guide

sumRn.blank: no precipitation only with an empty iscs and no positive sumRnDur

odam.granularity: grid, matched to a representative AWS station

availability.reach: most recent three days per APIHub guidance; data.go.kr reach unverified

RN1.meaning: categorical text, not an exact amount

hourly.rn1.missing: internal -1; omitted on the wire for recovered rows

hourly.rn3h.interval: preceding three hours, November to March marks only

slot.pty.window: hours T-2..T; 0000 belongs to the previous day as 2400

half.wf.missing: absent; under ASOS-primary also when the half has no known type (untyped-half-v1)

wire.half-icon.missing: omitted; the shared client shows the other half or no icon

edges.transform: phenomena-code-v1: supported unambiguous codes; non-precipitation codes become 0; unknown codes stay missing
qualified-blank-dry: a normal-QC blank with another valid measured field and a compatible code becomes 0 (winter only at marks)
numeric-including-trace: a normal-QC numeric amount, including 0.0, is precipitation unless ASOS itself set PTY 0
temperature-qualified-rain: an uncoded normal-QC amount at ta >= 5 C becomes PTY 1
edges.holdout: docs/evidence/research/kma-history-gap-options-2026-10-30.md#held-out-validation-of-proposed-rules-2026-10-31 (second holdout: sleet at ta 5.1 C, Jeju 2026-01-08); third holdout: a wet-bulb >= 2.5 C variant also failed, 3 of 198 hours

edges.transform: season-limited-wet-bulb-rain: in an April-October hour, an uncoded normal-QC amount at wet-bulb >= 5.0 C (Stull 2011) becomes PTY 1; a recorded type stays and the rule replaces a PTY 0 that the ASOS amount contradicts

winter-wet-bulb-rain: in a November-March hour, an uncoded normal-QC amount (the three-hour quantity at a mark) at wet-bulb >= 5.0 C (Stull 2011) becomes PTY 1; below that it stays unknown, and a recorded type stays
edges.holdout: docs/evidence/research/kma-history-gap-options-2026-10-30.md#fifth-held-out-sample-50-c-wet-bulb-rule-in-november-march-2026-11-08 (pre-registered November-March sample: 117 scored hours and 160 typed windows without a snow or mixed code; cutoff weakly challenged, warmest snow at 2.43 C wet-bulb; the third sample's data hold one window this rule types as rain, station 138, 2026-02-25 03:00, a trace at 6.18 C with sleet at 01:00). AK approved it on 2026-11-08.

edges.field: rn, rnQcflg, dmstMtphNo with asos-daily sumRn
edges.transform: qc9-closure-dry: April-October QC9 blank without a precipitation code is PTY 0 when hourly amounts equal the official daily total

edges.field: rn, rnQcflg, dmstMtphNo with asos-daily sumRn
edges.transform: winter-window-dry: a November-March QC9 mark with no precipitation code in its three hours is a dry window under the same closure

edges.field: sumRn with hourly rn and dmstMtphNo
edges.transform: dry-daily-total: a blank daily total is 0 mm when the day has no numeric hourly amount and no precipitation code

evidence-v1.summary: Precipitation evidence is a typed PTY, or an ASOS-provenance rain amount (rn1 or rn3h). A zero amount under an ASOS PTY 0 is a qualified dry hour and no evidence; a positive amount is evidence whatever the PTY.

summary-to-3h.summary: Legacy partial rule for recovered rows: PTY is the summary of known hours; unknown only when no hour is known.

day-summaries.summary: day_summary_list (hourly rows, the only path for past days under ASOS-primary) and day_summary_list_by_short (three-hour slots); both skip unknown values.

sky-to-kor.summary: AM/PM text from SKY and PTY.

sky-icon.summary: AM/PM icon from numeric SKY, PTY and LGT.

precipitation-guard-v1.summary: Under ASOS-primary only: a slot with precipitation evidence and no typed PTY gets PTY -1; such a half loses its PTY, SKY and text, keeps its date and is listed in missingDailyDates.

dry-closure-v1.summary: Under ASOS-primary only, per observation day 01:00..24:00 KST with all 24 latest hourly originals: when numeric hourly amounts (any QC) sum to sumRn, or sumRn is blank with no numeric hour, an April-October blank QC9 hour without a precipitation code gets rn1 0 and PTY 0 (R1b); a blank sumRn without numeric or coded hourly precipitation and without rain duration gets rn1 0 (D1). Days whose stored rain fields differ from their latest originals are skipped; only absent fields are filled. Hourly results are derived values, as below.

wet-bulb-rain-v2.summary: Under ASOS-primary only, per hour of the latest originals in every month (AK 2026-11-08; v1 covered April-October, AK 2026-11-03): a normal-QC numeric amount without a phenomenon code, with unflagged temperature and humidity of at least 5 %, gets a derived PTY 1 when the wet-bulb temperature (Stull 2011, humidity at most 99) is at least 5 C. A November-March amount is the three-hour quantity at a mark. Below 5 C the type stays unknown.

derived-precedence.summary: Hourly rule-derived values stay in the ASOS record field inferred, apart from measured values. merge_hourly applies them after measured ASOS, ODAM and VSRT, only where their fields are missing; a derived rain type also replaces PTY 0, and a recorded type always stays.

stored-read-window-v1.summary: Under ASOS-primary only, AK 2026-11-05: a request reads stored grid and RSS publications of the last 54 hours, which reach yesterday's first hour at any clock. A slot older than that takes no stored ODAM or VSRT field, so it has the values of a cell with no such publications.

station-altitude-v1.summary: Under ASOS-primary only, AK 2026-11-03: a town listed in data/town_elevations.csv keeps its nearest city station when any of three elevation estimates lies within 200 m of the station altitude. Otherwise it takes the nearest station within 35 km that all three estimates accept, or no station. An island station serves only its county and keeps it; Jeju stations serve only Jeju. Unlisted towns keep the nearest station. Stations 185 and 188 keep their measurements but not wind.

past-forecast-v1.summary: Under ASOS-primary only, AK 2026-11-08: a past three-hour row (label + 3 h <= now) keeps the stored publication's values for the fields no history source observes (probability, wave height, snow amount and text, wind components), as legacy _mergeShortWithCurrent keeps them, with the observed fields over them; without a stored publication it sends legacy's missing-forecast values. Its LGT is legacy _summaryLgt's value for its hours, 0 when none has one. Past days D-2 and D-1 take probability, rain and snow amounts and AM/PM LGT from those rows as legacy _getDaySummaryListByShort sums them, also when a half has no known type and so no text (legacy keeps only days with both texts); their types, texts and extremes stay observed. No older publication is read or acquired for a past row.

nowcast-fill-v1.summary: Under ASOS-primary only, AK 2026-11-08: an hour before today within the last 23 hours (the getUltraSrtNcst reach, publication::past_current_bases) whose type or amount the ASOS rules leave unknown (no PTY, or neither an hourly amount nor the three-hour amount of its winter mark) takes the cell's grid nowcast (ODAM, edge E3): read from S3, or acquired as owned single-flight work at most once per cell and base time (24 h retry bound), within the request wait. A late acquisition serves the next answer; an ASOS answer still loading or failed asks for nothing. Today's hours are required anyway.

untyped-half-v1.summary: Under ASOS-primary only, AK 2026-11-08: a past half whose hours have no known type has no text. day-summaries drops its PTY, but sky-to-kor reduces its text to the sky prefix, which is no weather text; that text is withheld too, and the date is listed in missingDailyDates. A half built from known hours (measured, rule-derived or filled by nowcast-fill-v1) keeps its type, sky and text.

invariants.statement: Precipitation evidence in a slot or half window never yields aggregate PTY 0 or a dry AM/PM text or icon; an unknown type stays missing.
A zero rain amount alone never means no precipitation; trace and a qualified dry blank stay distinguishable.
Missing rain never becomes 0. Snow and LGT have no history source: a past slot keeps the stored publication's snow amount and legacy _summaryLgt's LGT (past-forecast-v1).
Winter three-hour accumulations are neither split into hours nor counted twice.
KST 0000 belongs to the previous day as 2400, and AM includes 1200.
Sources without history permission and proposed rules are never selected for history.
A rule-derived hourly value never replaces a measured value or a recorded precipitation type from ASOS, ODAM or VSRT.
Under ASOS-primary, a listed town never reads a non-island station when all three of its elevation estimates lie more than 200 m from that station altitude.

Under ASOS-primary, a request reads no stored grid publication older than the read window, and how a cell's data is split between S3 and the providers does not change the response apart from that window's stored fields.

Under ASOS-primary, a past hour's nowcast is read or acquired only within the last 23 hours and only when the ASOS rules leave its precipitation unknown; it is acquired at most once per cell and base time, and a failure or a late answer leaves the hour unknown for that answer.

not_declared: SKY values and their source accuracy
snow amounts (ASOS hr3Fhsc, dsnw and sumDpthFhsc are unmapped)
daily rain totals other than the dry-day rule D1
